svg.title: AgentBuff: before and after
svg.desc: Before: Owner answers every customer chat personally, late at night. After: A customer service employee replies on WhatsApp and hands over orders for confirmation. Before: Sales recap is copied by hand from the cashier app. After: Buff pulls the week from Kasir POS and returns a table with best sellers and busy hours. Before: Running an AI agent needs a server, Docker, a terminal and API keys. After: Sign in with Google, pick an AI provider or log in with an existing subscription, start working. Before: Recurring checks depend on the owner remembering them. After: Routines run on a schedule and deliver results to Telegram, WhatsApp or the app. Before: Each business app needs its own login and manual token setup. After: Sign in with AgentBuff, and the agent connects to the app after purchase without pasting a token.
